title: rosa × dumetorum var. thedenii
intro: Rosa × dumetorum var. thedenii, commonly known as Rosa thedenii or Rosa dumetorum, is a hybrid rose species. It is a fragrant, thorny shrub native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Rosa × dumetorum var. thedenii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal properties.
